user.title: Casa 3D
user.description: Adds a sidebar panel with your home in 3D and your Home Assistant sensors placed in it. You draw the floor plan in the panel itself, with the “Editează” (Edit) button.

data_description.ntc_panel: Only if you also built the NTC sensor with the OLED display from this project (ESPHome firmware in the repository's esphome/ folder).
